units.titleZh: 語言與句型 × 數字與時間

passages.title: Language Tools: First Reading
passages.text: Our class made a paper for sports day. I wrote the date on it, but I wrote it wrong. The paper said the game was on the eighteenth. Amy said the date was the fifteenth. She does not like to speak to a big class, so I told the teacher for her. We made a new paper and put it on the wall. Some students came to read it. Now everyone knows which day is right.

passages.title: Numbers and Time: Second Reading
passages.text: My father asked me to speak to my uncle on the phone. My uncle lives far from us. He said he will come on the eighteenth and stay for some days. I asked which train he takes. He said the one at eight. I wrote this on paper so I will not get the date wrong. My mother was happy. She says my uncle is very funny.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Does this paper show the right date?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, I think the date is wrong.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Which day is the sports day?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It is on the eighteenth, not the fifteenth.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can you speak to the teacher about this?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, she is in the school office now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good, because some students want to know.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I will tell them from my seat.

passages.title: Numbers and Time: First Reading
passages.text: My grandmother is seventy this year. My mother is forty and my father is fifty. I am thirteen. We made a big card with all the numbers on it. My little sister put fourteen flowers on the front. I asked my grandmother if she was happy. She said she never counts her years. She only counts her friends. That was a good answer, and I still think about it now.

passages.title: Numbers and Time: Second Reading
passages.text: Our teacher asked us to count to ninety. Ben stopped at sixteen because he could not think. I helped him from seventeen to thirty. Then he went on to sixty by himself. After that he did nineteen and forty with no help. The teacher said he did well and gave him a book. Ben was very happy. He said he will never stop at sixteen again.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How old is your grandmother now?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: She is seventy this year.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can you count to ninety in English?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, but I still stop at sixteen sometimes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I never stop there. I stop at thirty.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Then we can help each other.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good. Can you come to my house soon?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, I will come on the weekend.

units.titleZh: 人物與家庭 × 數字與時間
units.titleEn: People and Family & Numbers and Time

passages.title: People and Family: First Reading
passages.text: My grandpa is a writer. He writes at home every morning. My grandma helps him read his work. On the weekend my parents take me to see them. My grandma made a cake for me because I am twelve now. My grandpa gave me a book about a butterfly. I read it that night in my room. After that I was very thirsty and drank some water.

passages.title: Numbers and Time: Second Reading
passages.text: We went to the zoo with my grandmother on the weekend. We saw a big panda eat its lunch. A man said good morning to my grandfather and called him sir. My grandfather was happy all day. Twenty children came with their parents too. It was hot and we were thirsty, so we sat under a tree. Tomorrow I will draw the panda for my grandma.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What does your grandpa do?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: He is a writer. He writes every morning.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Will you see your grandparents this weekend?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, my parents will take me tomorrow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How old are you now?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I am twelve. My grandma made me a cake.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That is nice. Are you thirsty now?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, can I have some water?

passages.title: School and Learning: First Reading
passages.text: We had art class after reading class today. I took out my pencil box and found my crayon was gone. Ben let me use his paint. I made a drawing of a snake on my paper. The wind came in the window and moved my page. My drawing fell down, but it was not wet. The teacher put it on the wall for everyone to see.

passages.title: School and Learning: Second Reading
passages.text: My homework was to write every letter of the alphabet. I did the first page at school and the second page at home. My pencil case was in my bag, so I used a pen. After that we went to the bookstore. My mother bought me a new pencil box and some bread. I ate the bread on the bus and read my new book.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Did you do your homework for reading class?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, I did two pages this morning.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can I use your crayon for my drawing?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sure, it is in my pencil box.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I want to paint a snake on this page.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Close the window first, because of the wind.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good idea. Do you want some bread?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I am very hungry.

units.titleZh: 食物與用餐 × 住家與物品
units.titleEn: Food and Meals & Home and Objects

passages.title: Food and Meals: First Reading
passages.text: My mother made dinner for us today. She put a big dish of salad on the table. My father made pork and a small steak. I do not like vegetable soup, so I said it was yucky. My mother said the salad was yummy and I should try it. I did try it, and it was good. After dinner we had a sweet snack with a little sugar.

passages.title: Food and Meals: Second Reading
passages.text: We went to the bank with my father on Saturday. A man there gave me a red balloon. After that we went home and I called my friend on my cellphone. I asked her to come to my house for a snack. We ate bread and one small dish of fruit. It was sweet and yummy. Then we went out to feed the birds near my window.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What is in that big dish on the table?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It is salad. My mother made it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is there any pork or steak today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, but eat some vegetable first.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The soup is yucky, but the salad is yummy.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Then take more salad and less soup.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can we have a sweet snack after dinner?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, but only a little sugar.

units.titleZh: 住家與物品 × 地點與交通
units.titleEn: Home and Objects & Places and Transport

passages.title: Home and Objects: First Reading
passages.text: My father works in an office in the city. On Saturday we took the bus to see him. We got off at the bus stop near his office. The light in his room was on and the window was open. He put some tape on a box for me and gave me a pen. After that we went to a restaurant on the road near the station.

passages.title: Places and Transport: Second Reading
passages.text: Our television is on the wall in the living room. My little brother watches TV after school every day. Today the TV was off because my mother wanted a quiet house. My brother put his socks on and we went out. We walked down the road to the station and back. He said the city is very big at night. My sister wore her new skirt.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Where does your father work?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: He works in an office in the city.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How do we get there from here?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We take the bus at the bus stop.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is there a restaurant near the station?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, there is a good one on that road.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Then let us eat there after we see him.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good. Put on your socks and we can go.

passages.title: Actions and Routines: First Reading
passages.text: We went to the beach and I did not want to swim at first. The water was cold, so I stayed on the sand. My sister said the water was better after some minutes. I did use her hat because the sun was hot. Then we did dig a big hole in the sand. My father said we should stop before lunch. It was the best day.

passages.title: Actions and Routines: Second Reading
passages.text: My mother sent me to buy some bread on the street near our house. She gave me money to pay for it. I did not worry because I go there often. On the way I saw my friend and we did stop to talk. I told her we will visit my aunt tomorrow. She said her cat did fall from a chair but was fine.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you want to swim with us today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The water is cold, so I will stay here.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It is better after some minutes.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Then I will use your hat and come in.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can you buy some bread on that street?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, my mother gave me money to pay.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do not worry, the shop is very near.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I know. I will not stop on the way.

passages.title: Colors and Descriptions: First Reading
passages.text: The weather was warm and sunny on Sunday. We went to the park and it was very cool under the trees. My friend Amy has long hair and she wore a pretty blue dress. She is smart and very funny too. We saw a strong man carry two big boxes to a car. I was sure he was tired after that. It was a wonderful day.

passages.title: Colors and Descriptions: Second Reading
passages.text: My little brother and I have the same shoes. His are small and mine are long. He fell in the water and his socks were wet. He was not sad because the day was warm. He is young, but he is strong. My mother said he is a funny child. We told her it was a wonderful day, and she said she was sure of that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The weather is warm and sunny today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, but it is cool under these trees.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Your new dress is very pretty.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Thank you. My sister has the same one.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is she the tall one with long hair?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, and she is very smart and funny.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are you sure she is only twelve?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I am sure. She is young but strong.

units.titleZh: 休閒與媒體 × 季節與天氣
units.titleEn: Fun and Media & Seasons and Weather

passages.title: Fun and Media: First Reading
passages.text: Summer vacation is my favorite season. In summer we swim every day and eat ice after lunch. In winter there is snow on the hills near my home. In spring we see flowers on the way to school. My father reads the newspaper for the news about the weather. He said tomorrow will be a good day for sport, so we will play soccer in the park.

passages.title: Seasons and Weather: Second Reading
passages.text: We went to see a movie on Saturday with my cousin. Before the movie we played soccer in the park. My cousin is very good at that sport. After the movie we went home and my mother put on a CD. My sister likes dancing to it. The news said there will be snow this winter. We want to see the snow in our vacation.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What do you do in the summer vacation?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We swim every day and play soccer.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is soccer your favorite sport?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, but I like dancing too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Did you see the news about the winter?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, my father read it in the newspaper.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It said there will be snow this season.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Then let us go to the hills in winter.

passages.title: Everyday English: First Reading
passages.text: We had a party for Chinese New Year at my grandma's house. My little kitten sat next to me all night. My mother put red paper in front of the door. Even my father made a dish for us. The food had a very good smell. We ate a big part of it and left a little on the table. Out on the road I could hear children play.

passages.title: Everyday English: Second Reading
passages.text: Our school has a sports day every spring. This year I did not know my shoe size, so my mother took me out to buy new ones. On the day I ran in two sports and did swimming after. My kitty came to the door when I got home. She made a small sound and sat next to my bag. Even my sister said I did well.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What do you do for Chinese New Year?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We go to my grandma's house for a party.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is your kitten there too?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, my kitty sits next to me all night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That red paper in front of the door is pretty.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: My mother put it there this morning.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you have sports day this spring?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, and I will do swimming this year.
